method: Three Luna agents reviewed every canonical problem. Parent applied exact formatting corrections in memory; ran the published MathContent React/remark-math/rehype-katex renderer; counted expected mathematical expressions; validated JSON/image decoding/dimensions/hashes.
scope: All 989 canonical problems across 97 collections; no sampling.
limits: This formatting audit does not repeat prior mathematical proofs or PDF visual comparisons. Source PDFs and canonical figures remain unchanged. Guided questions retain their grading restrictions. Generic option-analysis prose was not rewritten.
